description: The PK Trail is a long standing snowmobile trail to connect Chimney Valley to the Gold Rush Snowmobile Trail. Trail is a network of resource roads which are also suitable for summer ORV use.
directions: From Chimney Lake North Rec site, head across the road to resource road. Trail branches from that point to travel North or South.

stats.Closure:
The RecreationTrail is closed due to an active wildfire in the area. The area is
currently under Evacuation Alert. Find further information at www.bcwildfire.ca
